title: kronland-catalog
description: catalog.json of a static source or of the server, and the answer of GET /api/v1/packs (entries for the signed-in player). Relative URLs are relative to the catalog.

kind.description: Library tab: first = first steps, stories = stories, code = programming. Missing = stories.

difficulty.description: Optional; shown on the card and used by the library filter.

minutes.description: Optional; estimated play time of the whole pack in minutes.

added.description: Optional; date (YYYY-MM-DD) from which the pack is there. Recent packs the player has not opened yet carry the "New" badge.

access.description: open: can be loaded. locked: lock icon, the button "Learn more" opens `link`.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of pack.json (= the state of the pack).

link.description: Page about a locked pack (required for locked).

own.description: Own pack of the signed-in player (editable).
